verdict.rationale: AvaTax documents tax codes for products, with AI-ranked tax code recommendations from a product description, category, itemType or UPC. It also says it handles product taxability differences without custom rule engines, and its calculation is jurisdiction-aware across 200+ countries and jurisdictions. Together these cover the core of mapping a catalog to the vendor's taxability categories and taxing each item by what it is, wherever it sells. Missing for 10: an explicit list of tax code categories (SaaS, digital goods, services, physical goods), documentation of assigning a tax code per transaction line or catalog item, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
